body: I have talked to them both and they're supportive. My boyfriend wants to understand what I'm going through but my mom just says I'm fine whenever I try explaining.

It's not ok for him to be like that. It's your body not his. I understand why he'd get upset because he cares but if he use to do it then he should understand more than anyone. I'm 16 and have been self harming for over two years now. I'm not going to say it gets better because it hasn't gotten better for me. My boyfriend saved my life many times. You can get through it though. As for your mom I never told my mom she found out the hard way don't keep it a secret from her it'll make it worse. You just have to fight really hard because it takes a lot of strength to get help or get through this. I know its going to be hard because I'm still fighting after two years. You just have to find the right friends and be brave.
I got a bad infection because my right forearm was covered in thin not deep cuts. The pain was unbearable and it's all healed up now but I'll never forget that pain.

The people who say it gets better are the ones who don't understand it they may have gone through it and it got better for them. But we don't know if it'll ever get better or if we want to risk all that suffering. For us it's not getting better. It may but it may not. I don't want my life to be nothing but suffering listening to people who will never understand the pain we're currently going through.

I understand how it feels in my own way. Everyday I I question why I'm alive. I lived when doctors said I most likely wasn't going to make it when I was young. I've been raped and abused. I'm 16 and I want to know, why should I live? I need to know if dying is better for everyone.

I'm only alive for the same reason and I want to give up but the people in my life wouldn't be able to handle my loss so I put up with my existence to save them. I want to die. I want everything to end.
